data: Which models are trained on 10% of the dataset?

The question asks which models are trained on 10% of the dataset. From the caption, we know that Figure 3 shows accuracy on the validation set over time for models trained on either the full SLU dataset or 10% of the dataset. The subfigures are labeled (a) Full dataset and (b) 10% of the dataset. Therefore, the models trained on 10% of the dataset are represented in subfigure (b). The lines in this subfigure correspond to the same categories as in subfigure (a): No pre-training, No unfreezing, Unfreeze word layers, and Unfreeze all layers. Thus, the models trained on 10% of the dataset are those shown in subfigure (b).
